name: iron-wasteland
description: Phaser 3 browser game split across src/*.js. Edit and refresh — no build step.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: cat src/*.js > .lint-bundle.js && npx --yes eslint --no-eslintrc --config .eslintrc.json .lint-bundle.js; status=$?; rm -f .lint-bundle.js; exit $status
